reviewed_claims: Current resolve permission is distinct from invoke/effect permission and precedes query scanner processing and database opening.
Exact query inspection failure is a uniform unavailable failure before database lookup, even for a known retained completion.
Namespace fingerprint, metadata run identity, parent ownership and actor are verified before effect-specific lookup.
Effect identity and descriptor original commitment are bound to the selected logical key and retained namespace.
Bounded SQL byte selection, including multibyte UTF-8 text, precedes native JSON decoding.
One read-only SQLite transaction copies effect and completion consistently, then releases the connection before payload inspector callbacks.
Live-owner reads acquire no execution owner lock, perform no recovery or redispatch, and do not modify retained files.
Only a coherent completed receipt supports completed host settlement; external execution certainty is independently retained.
Nonterminal and originally withheld views expose null descriptor/output/evidence.
Current application schemas and complete exact-source inspection determine payload availability; validated host receipt metadata is not recursively rescanned as application content.
Policy byte limits and binding cover the entire returned envelope, including independently authorised metadata-only fallback.
Revocation observed during the payload callback denies the entire returned view.
An authorised not-recorded observation under a verified parent does not certify external non-execution or authorise a retry.
A2A derives the run and actor from an authenticated owned task rather than accepting client-supplied filesystem or invocation authority.
Case projection preserves independent snapshot and certainty dimensions; missing, withheld and unknown records do not fabricate a notification submission.

findings_and_repairs.finding: Scanning the available public envelope recursively rescanned nested host inspection receipts and could exhaust the 128-text-unit budget before the intended payload callback.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Inspect only application descriptor/output/reported_evidence; independently validate retained host inspection receipts; retain whole-envelope resolve policy and byte binding.

findings_and_repairs.finding: A descriptor.is_object conditional skipped all payload schema validation for a retained nonobject descriptor. An independent regression reproduced payload_disposition available.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Run validate_payload unconditionally for completed available payloads. After additional original-commitment hardening, descriptor substitution is unavailable; an explicitly fixture-rebound unsupported descriptor still exercises independent schema withholding.

findings_and_repairs.finding: The retained descriptor required explicit correspondence to its admitted original commitment, including schema-valid substitutions.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Read bounded governed_inputs.original_commitment for the exact effect in the same read-only transaction and compare the session commitment of the retained descriptor. Missing or mismatched admission is uniformly unavailable.

findings_and_repairs.finding: A restored or copied journal at another run basename required explicit rejection rather than implicit namespace rebinding.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Require directory basename to equal retained metadata.run_id before parent/effect lookup.

findings_and_repairs.finding: Resolve permission must authorise query processing before invoking the inspector, with current whole-view checks retained after processing.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Perform current resolve query precheck before inspect_boundary; reauthorise after query and result processing.

findings_and_repairs.finding: The initial finite model copied protected effect state before its namespace/parent/actor gates, unlike the required implementation ordering.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Model namespace/header, parent and actor gates before protected row lookup; assert lookup implies every verified identity flag. Preserve atomic effect/receipt snapshot and connection release before callbacks.

findings_and_repairs.finding: The result-inspection abstraction needed its own current full-payload precheck, separate from the earlier query check and the later final-view authorisation.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Retain distinct result_inspection_precheck and post-inspection final_check, with an explicit permitted final-check-to-return race witness.
